nom: TONYMOLY Mask Melt Multi-Zone Forehead + Neck Mask

avis.titre: Forehead, maybe. Not good for necks.
avis.texte: Dear God don't try to sleep with this on your neck, it won't stay in place. When The packaging says to keep your chin uplifted, they mean it. I have to have my head tilted all the way back in order to keep this from folding in on itself or rolling off. I cannot sleep like this. that also means that I cannot wear it standing up during the day walking around I can't wear it doing anything other than having my head tilted towards the ceiling just so this will stay in place on my neck. What a waste of money as a neck mask.
Maybe I just have a smaller forehead but this is huge! It covered my eyebrows and went below my brow bone, almost covering half my eyes.

I gotta say, I much prefer these jelly type masks over the old school style. These stay in place perfectly & feel great on the skin! I applied this to my forehead & it felt so smooth afterwards. I'm did my makeup afterwards & my 40 y/o skin looked incredible! So smooth & plump! My only complaint, it this is a little large & I have a big head/forehead. lol It goes into my widows peak, so if you have a small forehead, these could get wild. lol I would definitely use these again tho! *Gifted by tonymoly

Most people love to wear this mask to sleep, but I love that I can wear it while doing my Sunday resets! It doesn't move an inch while I'm cleaning around my house and when I'm done my neck and forehead are glowing and wrinkle free. Complimentary from tonymoly

I absolutely loved using this face mask. It didn't bother me at all when sleeping with it on before going to bed. I woke up with my forehead looking so smooth and shiny. I cannot wait to use this mask again. This was gifted by Tonymoly.

This is an interesting idea and new take on face masks. It was easy to apply and didn't slip and slide off! It felt very hydrating on my forehead and neck. My skin did feel itchy at one point but there was no irritation. Gifted by tonymoly

I didn't really expect to do much after one use, but I was very impressed. I used the patch on my forehead. I don't have a lot of wrinkles to begin, but after using this patch one night, my forehead was incredibly smooth the next morning and genuinely looked like I got tox injections (I've never had them btw). The result seemed to last throughout the day. The patch was easily to apply and remove, and it stayed in place all night. I will be purchasing more of these. [Gifted by TonyMoly]

L I didn't realize how much my forehead and neck needed some extra love until I tried this. The serum feels cooling and melts right into the skin — super hydrating without being sticky. I left it on while getting ready for bed and woke up with my skin feeling noticeably smoother and tighter. It's perfect before makeup or just for a self-care night. My new favorite mask for that lifted, fresh glow. Gifted by tonymoly

Complimentary from tonymoly. I wish I could tell you how this went, but it didn't even last 5 minutes. If you have nails, it's going to rip it. I had it on my neck and it kept moving, slipping and adjusting it made it worse, because after adjusting it many times, it ripped.

I'm obsessed with the Multi-Zone Mask Melt Hydrogel Masks! They feel so cooling and refreshing on my skin, and I love how each zone targets something different , it's like a mini spa treatment at home. My skin looks smoother and more radiant right after using it. Definitely a new favorite in my self-care routine! Gifted by tonymoly

Absolutely love this on my skin. I felt so hydrated and it looked really cute. Definitely recommend for like a weekly mask! Travels. Great I did this on a plane and loved it left feeling it super soft and not dry. Gifted by tonymoly.

Gifted by TonyMoly. This face mask was very nice & I enjoyed using it. It helped the appearance of my textured skin look minimal immediately after use. My skin felt smooth & soft. My skin looked brighter & glowy. Enjoyed.

I tried the Mask Melt Multi-Zone Forehead + Neck Mask, and it feels super soothing and hydrating. The forehead patch smooths fine lines while the neck mask leaves my skin soft and firm. I love that it stays in place and gives a spa-like feel at home. It's perfect for a self-care night, though I wish it came with a bit more serum. Gifted by tonymoly. it dries out a little fast.

I have never seen a targeted gel mask before! I love the concept and it actually really works to target problem areas. It stays on well and my skin feels firmer/plumper. Would definitely recommend. Especially for the price! Gifted by Tonymoly

complimentary from tonymoly. In the morning, my skin looked plumper and more refreshed. I noticed less dryness in my forehead area and my makeup went on smoother after using it. It's not a miracle overnight, but after a few uses I definitely saw my skin looking healthier and more hydrated. Recommend trying.

complimentary from tonymoly. In the morning, my skin looked plumper and more refreshed. I noticed less dryness in my forehead area and my makeup went on smoother after using it. It's not a miracle overnight, but after a few uses I definitely saw my skin looking healthier and more hydrated. Recommend trying.

Wow this is so good I used this on the plane and it was amazing! My face felt so refreshed and I can tell it really hydrated my skin. I left it on for a while and my skin was glowing! So good for the price! Gifted by tonymoly

I received this product for free, gifted by only! And honestly I love this face mask. It makes my face feel so clean and pure, and it's very hydrating. It smells good and doesn't leave my skin dry. I only got one mask but I wish I had more!
